simple.meaning: מָמוֹת (mâmôwth) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a mortal disease ; concretely, a corpse.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 3 times in 2 Kings, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, beginning at 2 Kings 11:2. The surrounding contexts include family, family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָמוֹת (H4463) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מָמוֹת (mâmôwth) / H4463 is traced through 2 Kings 11:2, Jeremiah 16:4, Ezekiel 28:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: a mortal disease ; concretely, a corpse
definitions.full: H4463. mamoth [ מָמוֺת ] noun [masculine] only plural death (compare Arabic ); — construct תַחֲלֻאִים מְמוֺתֵי Jer 16:4 of painful death by diseases ; ׳מ חָלָל Ezek 28:3 . — For הַמְּמוֺתִים (Kt) 2Kin 11:2 , the slain , Qr. הַמּוּמָתִים is certainly correct (see מוּת Hoph`al above) (לְ)מוֺתָם Psa 73:4 see [ חַרְצֻבָּה ] and תָּם 1

occurrences.englishText: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

“They will die grievous deaths. They will not be lamented, neither will they be buried. They will be as dung on the surface of the ground. They will be consumed by the sword and by famine. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.”
They will bring you down to the pit.
